Pixel Pals includes a variety of animals for you to customize and enjoy:

- Dog (named Rupert)
- Cat (named Hugo)
- Hedgehog (named Chortley)
- Fox (named Finnegan)
- Axolotl (named Mochi)
- Otter (named Nugget)
- Bat (named Fu-Fu)
- Parrot (named Kiwi)
- Tiger (named Herbert)
- Platypus (named Penny)
- Panda (named Poe)
- Raccoon (named Oliver)

You can also change any of the names!

The dog and cat are included for all, and Pixel Pals Premium includes the other pals, as well as the option to pin two animals at once for supported devices.

This app offers subscriptions for "Pixel Pals Premium". They're available (in United States pricing) for $1.49 monthly or $9.99 yearly. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (and charged to your iTunes account). You can turn off auto-renew/manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Terms of Use can be found at https://pixelpals.app/terms and Privacy Policy can be found at https://pixelpals.app/privacy
